product.name: M110 Bluetooth Thermal Label Maker
product.description: A compact phone-connected thermal printer for small black-and-white labels used to organize items such as cables, containers, folders, and retail stock.

script_facts: This compact label maker prints small black-and-white labels using direct thermal paper instead of an ink cartridge.
A companion phone app is required to design and send labels over Bluetooth.
The supported label-width range is 20 to 50 millimetres.
Small labels can be used to organize items such as cables, containers, and folders.
prohibited_claims: Do not claim color printing or operation without the companion app.
Do not claim that every label size or third-party roll is compatible.
Do not claim waterproof, fade-proof, archival, or shipping-label performance.
Do not claim that the printer or its templates are free to use.
editorial_direction: Lead with an unlabeled drawer, cable, or container becoming easy to identify.
Show the phone-app step and the printed label as one compact workflow.
Focus on the visible organization use case rather than specifications or sales language.
Do not name the brand, model, marketplace, price, rating, or review count in narration.
Close on a concrete organization result without a viewer question or sales prompt.
